//! KRA-20 baseline golden generator (TEST-ONLY, never committed to the baseline branch).
//!
//! Copy to `<baseline-worktree>/crates/krausen-app/tests/zz_baseline_golden.rs` at
//! 4fc8313, set KRAUSEN_GOLDEN_OUT, and run:
//!   KRAUSEN_GOLDEN_OUT=/home/jason/.cache/krausen/tmp-kra20/golden \
//!   cargo test -p krausen-app --test zz_baseline_golden -- --nocapture
//!
//! It seeds fixed identities, saves a fixed equipment profile and recipe through the
//! public application operations, then records the baseline v1 CalculationContext,
//! its digest, targets, validation and style comparison. The KRA-20 branch commits the
//! generated files as fixtures; it must not synthesize them.
use krausen_app::{ActorContext, equipment, formulation, recipe_editor};
use krausen_core::{DbPool, canonical_json};
use krausen_types::{
    brewery::{
        AdditionStage, ChillingV1, EquipmentProvenance, EquipmentSettingsV1, FermentableAddition,
        FermentableSpecification, ProcessV1, RecipeDocumentV1, StyleReference,
    },
    equipment::SaveEquipment,
    formulation::{PreviewOutcome, PreviewRequest},
    recipe_editor::RecipeSaveOutcome,
    request_context::OperationIntent,
    validation::Readiness,
};

const USER: &str = "kra20-baseline-user";
const WORKSPACE: &str = "kra20-baseline-workspace";
const CREDENTIAL: &str = "kra20-baseline-credential";
const PROFILE: &str = "4fc83130-0000-4000-8000-000000000003";
const EXPIRES_AT: i64 = 4_102_444_800;

fn intent(actor: &ActorContext) -> OperationIntent {
    OperationIntent {
        account_id: actor.actor_id.clone(),
        workspace_id: actor.workspace_id.clone(),
    }
}

fn equipment_settings() -> EquipmentSettingsV1 {
    EquipmentSettingsV1 {
        mash_efficiency_fraction: Some(0.75),
        boil_off_l_per_hour: Some(3.0),
        transfer_loss_l: Some(2.0),
        pre_boil_deadspace_l: Some(0.0),
        grain_absorption_l_per_kg: Some(0.8),
        mash_thickness_l_per_kg: Some(2.5),
        kettle_capacity_l: Some(30.0),
        kettle_diameter_cm: Some(35.0),
        kettle_opening_cm: Some(30.0),
        boil_temperature_c: Some(100.0),
        chilling: Some(ChillingV1::Natural),
        ..Default::default()
    }
}

fn recipe(profile_id: &str) -> RecipeDocumentV1 {
    RecipeDocumentV1 {
        schema_version: 1,
        title: "KRA-20 baseline golden".into(),
        style: Some(StyleReference {
            name: "Munich Helles".into(),
            edition: Some("BJCP 2021".into()),
            style_id: Some("4A".into()),
        }),
        batch_size_l: Some(20.0),
        boil_minutes: Some(60.0),
        equipment_profile_id: Some(profile_id.into()),
        fermentables: vec![FermentableAddition {
            row_id: "grain-1".into(),
            amount_kg: Some(4.2),
            addition: AdditionStage {
                stage: "mash".into(),
                time_minutes: None,
            },
            specification: FermentableSpecification {
                name: Some("Pilsner malt".into()),
                producer: Some("Weyermann".into()),
                kind: Some("grain".into()),
                yield_fraction: Some(0.8),
                colour_ebc: Some(5.0),
            },
            source: None,
        }],
        // Deliberately omit the two engine defaults so V2 must record the actually
        // applied fallbacks while producing the same numeric targets as V1.
        process: ProcessV1 {
            apparent_attenuation_fraction: Some(0.78),
            mash_water_l: Some(15.0),
            mash_water_method: Some("manual".into()),
            whirlpool_minutes: None,
            kettle_top_up_l: None,
            ..Default::default()
        },
        ..Default::default()
    }
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn generate_baseline_golden() {
    let out_dir = std::env::var("KRAUSEN_GOLDEN_OUT")
        .expect("KRAUSEN_GOLDEN_OUT must point at the golden output directory");
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&out_dir).unwrap();

    let pool = sqlx::sqlite::SqlitePoolOptions::new()
        .max_connections(1)
        .connect("sqlite::memory:")
        .await
        .unwrap();
    sqlx::migrate!("../../apps/server/migrations-sqlite")
        .run(&pool)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    sqlx::query("INSERT INTO users (user_id,email) VALUES ($1,$2)")
        .bind(USER)
        .bind(format!("{USER}@example.test"))
        .execute(&pool)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    sqlx::query("INSERT INTO workspaces (workspace_id,owner_user_id) VALUES ($1,$2)")
        .bind(WORKSPACE)
        .bind(USER)
        .execute(&pool)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    sqlx::query(
        "INSERT INTO workspace_users (workspace_id,user_id,role) VALUES ($1,$2,'workspace_member')",
    )
    .bind(WORKSPACE)
    .bind(USER)
    .execute(&pool)
    .await
    .unwrap();
    sqlx::query(
        "INSERT INTO auth_credentials (credential_id,user_id,kind,issuer,audience,expires_at) VALUES ($1,$2,'browser','test','test',$3)",
    )
    .bind(CREDENTIAL)
    .bind(USER)
    .bind(EXPIRES_AT)
    .execute(&pool)
    .await
    .unwrap();

    let db = DbPool::Sqlite(pool);
    let actor = ActorContext {
        actor_id: USER.into(),
        workspace_id: WORKSPACE.into(),
        credential_id: CREDENTIAL.into(),
        access_expires_at: EXPIRES_AT,
    };

    let saved = equipment::save(
        &db,
        &actor,
        SaveEquipment {
            intent: intent(&actor),
            profile_id: PROFILE.into(),
            name: "KRA-20 baseline kettle".into(),
            settings: equipment_settings(),
            provenance: EquipmentProvenance {
                source: "KRA-20 baseline golden fixture".into(),
                assumptions: vec!["brewhouse_loss_calibrated".into()],
            },
            expected_revision: 0,
            expected_metadata_revision: 0,
            request_id: "4fc83130-0000-4000-8000-000000000001".into(),
        },
    )
    .await
    .expect("baseline equipment profile");

    let document = recipe(&saved.profile_id);
    let RecipeSaveOutcome::Saved {
        recipe_id,
        revision,
    } = recipe_editor::save(
        &db,
        &actor,
        &intent(&actor),
        None,
        None,
        &document,
        uuid::Uuid::parse_str("4fc83130-0000-4000-8000-000000000002").unwrap(),
    )
    .await
    else {
        panic!("baseline recipe save");
    };
    assert_eq!(revision, 1);

    let PreviewOutcome::Preview(preview) = formulation::preview(
        &db,
        &actor,
        PreviewRequest {
            draft_generation: "kra20-baseline-golden".into(),
            intent: intent(&actor),
            draft: document.clone(),
            equipment_draft: Default::default(),
        },
    )
    .await
    .expect("baseline preview")
    else {
        panic!("baseline preview unavailable");
    };
    assert_eq!(preview.validation.state, Readiness::Ready);
    let context = preview.context.clone().expect("baseline context");
    let canonical = canonical_json::from_serializable(&context).expect("canonical context");
    let digest = canonical_json::sha256(&canonical).expect("baseline digest");
    assert_eq!(preview.context_digest.as_deref(), Some(digest.as_str()));
    assert_eq!(context.policy_version, "krausen-formulation-v1");
    assert_eq!(
        context.policy_source_hash,
        "c2195592083a8abe4b735d78aa22d7006adb773046d480b78b6462d2699d3bb9"
    );

    let write = |name: &str, body: Vec<u8>| {
        std::fs::write(format!("{out_dir}/{name}"), body).expect("write golden file");
    };
    // The committed baseline envelope is the v1 raw canonical Value. It has no
    // `applied_defaults` key; do not round-trip it through the current
    // CalculationContext before hashing, because V2 serde would add `[]`.
    write(
        "baseline_4fc8313_context.pretty.json",
        serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&canonical).unwrap(),
    );
    write("baseline_4fc8313_digest.txt", format!("{digest}\n").into_bytes());
    write(
        "baseline_4fc8313_targets.json",
        serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&preview.targets).unwrap(),
    );
    write(
        "baseline_4fc8313_validation.json",
        serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&preview.validation).unwrap(),
    );
    write(
        "baseline_4fc8313_style_comparison.json",
        serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&preview.style_comparison).unwrap(),
    );
    write(
        "baseline_4fc8313_fixture.json",
        serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&serde_json::json!({
            "profile_id": PROFILE,
            "profile": saved,
            "recipe_id": recipe_id,
            "revision": revision,
            "document": document,
            "draft_generation": "kra20-baseline-golden",
            "engine_version": context.engine_version,
            "engine_build": context.engine_build,
            "engine_source_hash": context.engine_source_hash,
        }))
        .unwrap(),
    );
    eprintln!("baseline golden written to {out_dir}; digest={digest}");
}
